notes: The agent’s operating contract is now a strict loop: PLAN → BUILD → TEST — PASS delivers the structured ✅ SELESAI summary, FAIL goes back to BUILD with the evidence, and the loop repeats until the verification passes. Retry discipline has teeth: every failed round must carry a concrete hypothesis, blind trial-and-error is forbidden, and after 5 fix rounds the agent stops and escalates with the full story. The same loop — and the same rigor — now applies to every project kind: web, CLI, bot, API, library, pipeline.
